reason: Product claims and visible qualifications are supported, with the earlier PDF-link ambiguity resolved. Overall production acceptance still lacks perceptual evidence for two explicit requirements: smooth natural narration and absence of audible source music. No added music, unchanged pitch/speed, measured levels and ASR do not establish either requirement after learned vocal separation. This is an evidence gap, not an observed audio defect.

evidence.finding: 15.99 SAR is explicitly owner-supplied for ad copy, without claiming a store-settings edit. The rendered CTA at 27.650s and 29.700s matches it.

Independent local PDF inspection in my pre-freeze check verified 34 pages, matching SHA-256 de78fbb1468cbd7cdb635649500476022f3bbf8e6cc7c242bd6f690db54c34d5, 226 YouTube annotations and 43 distinct YouTube URLs. At 15.700s the encoded frame explicitly scopes explanation links to the PDF; no app video playback is claimed.

Training-day fields are 5 and 4. My independent source count found 500 distinct recipe IDs/names. The source discloses calculated suggestions, pending professional review and USDA-based estimates; the ad does not claim clinical validation.

Viewed both encoded sheets. Product, menu, 4/5-day programs, calculator and portion demonstration, protected captions and held price CTA are visible. At 18.550s the example/estimated-requirements label is visible; at 22.775s the app demonstration explicitly labels nutrition estimates. Recipe 1.5-portion figures correspond to the source recipe: 309.25 kcal x1.5=463.875 kcal. No quantified physique result, fixed transformation deadline or explicit guaranteed result appears in the reviewed copy.

Inspected records report 1080x1920, 60/1 fps, 1788 frames/29.8s, video SHA-256 0d741b5bef0424be521ba9938e891d8a4f6163b7e075e4cab592f3f8f8ff3940, early book visibility, 3.45s settled CTA, matching live assets and working downloads. These are recorded checks, not tests rerun by me.

Records preserve source narration with three segments, no pitch change/time stretch/synthesized voice, light EQ and nine effects. Separation expressly states approximate background removal and no proof of naturalness/perfect music removal; humanListening=false. ASR contains recognition errors and is explicitly not human verification.

strengths: Traceable claim-to-source mapping with truthful nutrition limits.
PDF explanation links are distinguished from unavailable app technique-video playback.
Owner price is shown without fabricated discount, urgency or result figures.

issues.requirement: Smooth natural source narration and no music
issues.needed_evidence: A competent human audition of the encoded final audio, including joins near 1.96s and 4.31s and the remainder through 26.01s, documenting intelligibility/naturalness and whether residual source music is audible. Existing numeric and ASR records cannot substitute.

issues.detail: بدون تخمين and واعرف إنك ماشي صح express broad certainty. Nearby visible estimate qualifications mitigate this; I do not read the present copy as a quantified result guarantee. Avoid strengthening these phrases into medical or universal-suitability promises.

objections: Do not describe this vote as full production approval or certify perceptual audio quality from the available machine evidence.
limitations: I inspected still contact/handoff sheets and source/test records, not continuous playback or human-heard audio.
Third-party explanation-link availability and technique quality were not independently checked.
Live verification is the supplied recorded result; store checkout, actual live product price, fulfillment and audience conversion were not verified.
non_applicable_criteria: Unrelated infrastructure/security changes, payment/store administration, medical certification and measured sales performance are outside this ad review.
